name: fluid-box-experimental-update-compat-shim
title: Fluid Box 2.1.22 Compat Shim
author: ezonius
description: Generic compatibility shim for the Factorio 2.1.22 experimental release: FluidBox::minimum_temperature/maximum_temperature were removed. Migrates them to the new machine-level minimum/maximum_input_temperature (and thruster fuel/oxidizer) properties in any mod, so broken mods load again.
